status: EXPERIMENTAL SIMULATION; NOT PROOF OF REAL ROBOT

model.servo_torque_speed_model: linear decline to zero at no-load speed, additionally capped by max_motor_torque_Nm; not a measured curve
model.side_push: 0.200 N for 0.15 s at 6 s, applied 40 mm above modeled base COM
model.collision: sole convex polygon extruded 5.02 mm; body/head/legs are boxes; self-collision off
model.inertia: solid CAD inertia for printed parts; assumed uniform box inertia for hardware; assembled actual inertia not measured
model.mass_model: solid PLA model, known hardware masses plus explicitly assumed small components

limitations: A sensorless position controller and limit are approximations; exact servo speed/torque/current unknown
Ground friction and floor properties assumed; contact modeling and sole stiffness unknown
Collision shapes use sole hulls and simple body/leg boxes; self-collision, horns and wires not simulated
Masses and inertias are incomplete/estimated; CAD servo positions and axes assumed
No hardware validation, electronics/power sag, print tolerance, bearing friction or joint backlash
